method: Actual complete Linux SDL game process. Mobile test rebuilds host.cpp and settings.cpp with PAL_OHOS_DEFAULTS + PAL_OHOS_DISPLAY, flat Fold{} bridge and no-op orientation request. LD_PRELOAD test-only hook injects real SDL_PushEvent touch/key events, calls SDL_SetWindowSize, captures actual renderer via SDL_RenderReadPixels. SDL offscreen/software/dummy audio. Not HarmonyOS or physical device verification.
checks: Landscape below split, picture drag saved x21/y22/scale70
Same-orientation resize releases active drag but preserves draft
Rotation during touch draft cancels unsaved draft without portrait pollution
Portrait fixed right split saves picture x0/y80/scale70 independently
Return to landscape restores below split, x21/y22 and saved dpad
Full process restart reloads both profiles; settings file SHA256 unchanged
Official desktop binary ignores mobile profiles and remains full-window overlay in landscape and portrait; actual keyboard AC Back opens/closes menu
limitations: No physical DPI/high-density screen, hardware GPU, multitouch driver, fold bridge or HarmonyOS lifecycle verified
Screenshots show startup logo/movie, not completed gameplay or device acceptance
Xvfb socket creation unavailable in sandbox; offscreen driver is not desktop screenshot
